_comment: One entry per published bundle. `layers` lists the override directories to stack, in order — a later layer shadows an earlier one. Add a directory + an entry here to publish another server's DB.

rathena-pre-re.description: Stock rAthena pre-renewal, plus the recipes and quests the script parsers drop as orphans. No server-specific content.

cyro.description: rathena-pre-re plus cyro's own NPCs (Hat Maker).
